summary: Batch B (Items 9/10/11) tested. Backend 11 passed, 1 skipped (test_batch_b_9_10_11.py). Frontend: Item 9 fully verified (Grounds heading, sidebar 'Grounds', no Venues tab, all 15 modal data-testids present, Add Ground modal opens). Item 10 fully verified (MPCA sees Signed Minutes section with upload-signed-minutes-btn; Division sees section without button and message 'MPCA has not yet uploaded signed minutes'). Item 11 UI panel could NOT be verified end-to-end because /squads/{sid} SquadDetail page throws 'Squad not found in your scope.' even for MPCA persona (pre-existing bootstrap bug — see RCA). Source of SquadDetail.jsx does contain all required data-testids (squad-ai-review-panel/verdict/rerun/comments and the 'MPCA makes the final call' string), so the panel implementation is present; only the page's loading path is broken.

ui_bugs.issue: Opening /squads/{sid} directly renders 'Squad not found in your scope.' even for MPCA persona. Bootstrap calls /squads/{sid}/recommendation (404) then iterates /tournaments + fetchSquads for each — this fallback fails to locate the squad even though direct GET /squads/{sid} and /tournaments/{tid}/squads both work via curl. Should simply call GET /squads/{sid} which the backend already exposes.

rca of the issue: SquadDetail.jsx (lines 59-82) tries GET /squads/{sid}/recommendation first (endpoint doesn't exist → 404), then falls back to iterating GET /tournaments and calling fetchSquads per tournament. Even though the squad and its tournament are reachable via direct API calls (curl verified for MPCA persona), the browser-side iteration ends up throwing 'Squad not found in your scope.' — the fallback path is not reliable. Fix: replace bootstrap with GET /squads/{sid} directly (routes/selection_console.py:28 already provides it) and use squad.tournament_id to fetch the tournament.
